primary_sources.title: Hidden Translation and Translating Coset in Quantum Computing
primary_sources.authors: Katalin Friedl, Gabor Ivanyos, Frederic Magniez, Miklos Santha, Pranab Sen
primary_sources.inspected: Section3, homogeneous degree(p-1) inequation lifting, Lemmas3.2-3.4, TranslationFinding and Theorem3.5.
primary_sources.supports: fixed-prime elementary-abelian hidden translation is an established polynomial baseline; polynomial inequation lifting is known
primary_sources.does_not_supply_for_free: The oracle zero/scalar checks in TranslationFinding are not available in an arbitrary copy-only input interface. Growing prime/exponent, physical source preparation and robust noisy equations are distinct debts.

local_derivations_review_pending: The fixed anti-trine source measurement supplies affine exclusions for every secret including zero.
Lifting symmetric products and linear secret entries avoids a separate hidden value-oracle scalar check.
Each nonzero lifted dual row polynomial escapes with probability at least one third under the declared IID source.
Independent equal-contrast dephasing gives the exact false-exclusion probability and strict-decoder bounds.
